whyAdmitted: Brought in by ambulance with sudden severe breathlessness waking her from sleep 2 hours ago.
whatHasBeenDone: Placed on simple face mask at 10 L/min by the ambulance crew.
currentSupport: Simple face mask 10 L/min. Sits bolt upright, diaphoresis, coughing pink frothy sputum.
theWorry: SpO2 is 84% despite 10 L/min oxygen; severe hypertension (BP 198/108 mmHg) and tachycardia (HR 124 bpm) in respiratory extremis.
background: Hypertension, ischemic cardiomyopathy (ejection fraction 35%), previous MI 4 years ago. Medication compliance recently interrupted.
